items.mainDefect: The new postgres skip means TestIntegrationWillRunInstrumentationServerWhenTargetHasNoHttpServer never runs on postgres, so a broken instrumentation /metrics endpoint on postgres would go unnoticed.

secondary.defect: The skip is broader than its stated reason: it disables the test for local postgres runs too, not just in Drone CI, so it should check a CI environment variable or skip only the failing assertion.
